observations.body: David is placed after Nathan, compared to fat separated from an offering, remembered for beasts and Goliath, praised for songs, and credited with arranging festival worship.

observations.body: The passage keeps David, Nathan, lion, bear, Goliath, singers, altar servants, and the Lord, wilderness, battlefield, sanctuary, and festival worship, being selected, fighting, calling on God, praising, composing, arranging singers, and beautifying feasts visible within David's story or later memory.

payload.posture: Read Sirach 47:1–11 as its own royal, poetic, and prophetic memory David setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places a later portrait compresses warrior and worship organizer into one praise sequence inside this David setting without explaining every motive, transition, or later consequence.
